€10U. (ताडयति-ते, ताडित) 
__1 To beat, strike (in general), dash against; गाहन्तां महिषा निपानसलिलं शृङ्गैर्मुहुस्ताडितम् [[Ś. 2. 6]]; (नौः) ताडिता मारुतैर्यथा [[Rām.]]; [[R. 3. 61]]; [[Ku. 5. 24]]; [[Bh. 1. 50.]] 
__2 To beat, strike, punish by beating, hit; लालयेत्पञ्च बर्षाणि दश वर्षाणि ताडयेत् [[Chāṇ. 11]], 12; न ताडयेत्तृणेनापि [[Ms. 4. 169]]; पादेन यस्ताड्यते [[Amaru. 52.]] 
__3 To strike, beat (as a drum); ताड्यमानासु भेरीषु [[Mb.]]; अताडयन् मृदङ्गांश्च [[Bk. 17. 7]]; [[Ve. 1. 22.]] 
__4 To play on, strike the wires of (a musical instrument); श्रोतुर्बितन्त्रीरिव ताड्यमाना [[Ku. 1. 45.]] 
__5 To shine. 
__6 To speak. 
__7 (In astr.) To strike against, touch, obscure or eclipse partially; [[Bṛ. S. 24. 34.]] 
__8 (In Math.) To multiply.

a. Beating. 
-डिः Striking, a stroke.

a. [तड् भावे अच्] Beating, striking. 
-डः 
__1 A blow, knock, thumb, whipping, chastisement; विपाटयिष्यत्ययमुत्तमेन सद्धर्मताडेन दुरासदेन [[Bu. Ch. 1. 80.]] 
__2 Noise, sound. [Page0754-1] 
__3 A sheaf. 
__4 A mountain. 
-Comp. 
-घ a. beating with a whip or strokes of any kind. 
-घः, -घातः an artificer who beats or hammers, a smith.

ताड,
ताडनम् &c. See under तड्.

a. [तड् भावे ल्युट्] Beating, whipping, striking. 
-नम् 
__1 Beating, whipping, flogging; लालने बहवो दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः [[Chāṇ. 12]]; अवतंसोत्पलताडनानि वा [[Ku. 4. 8]]; [[Ś. Til. 9.]] 
__2 (In astr.) Touching, partial eclipse; [[Bṛ. S. 24. 34.]] 
-ना Striking. 
-नी A whip.
p. p. Struck, beaten, chastised; स्थिताः क्षणं पक्ष्मसु ताडिताधराः [[Ku. 5. 24.]]
a. Beating, striking.

a. Being beaten or struck; श्रोतुर्बितन्त्रीरिव ताड्यमाना [[Ku. 1. 45]]; ताड्यमानः किं न ब्रूयात् [[Mu. 5.]] 
-नः A musical instrument struck with a stick &c. (as a drum).
See तडाग.

तडागः,
 
-गम् 
__1 A pond, deep pool, tank; स्फुटकमलोदरखेलितखञ्जनयुगमिव शरदि तडागम् [[Gīt. 11]]; [[Ms. 4. 203]]; [[Y. 3. 237.]] 
__2 A tank. 
__3 A trap for catching deer.

A pond, pool. 
-का 
__1 A blow. 
__2 A bank, shore. 
__3 Splendour, lustre.
See तटाघात; (उच्चैःकरिकराक्षेपे तडाघातं विदुर्बुधाः [[Śabdak.]]).

f. 
__1 Lightning; घनं घनान्ते तडितां गुणैरिब [[Śi. 1. 7]]; [[Me. 77]]; [[R. 6. 65]]; तडितो मानुषतां गता इब [[Śāhendra. 2. 71.]] 
__2 Killing, injury. -ind. Closely, near. 
-Comp. 
-गर्भः a cloud. 
-लता forked lightning. 
-लेखा a streak of lightning.
a. Containing or having lightning; अवरोहति शैलाग्रं तडित्वानिव तोयदः [[V. 1. 14]]; समुदितं निचयेन तडित्वतीम् [[Ki. 5. 4.]] -m. A cloud; [[Śi. 1. 12.]]
a. Consisting of lightning; [[Ku. 5. 25.]]
N. of an excellent breed of horses; ताडजा -उत्तमाशाश्च Aśvachikitsā.

ता(ट)डका
 
__1 N. of a female fiend, daughter of Suketu, wife of Sunda and mother of Mārīcha. [She was changed into a fiend by the sage Agastya whose devotions she had disturbed. She was killed by Rāma when she began to disturb, the sacrificial rites of Viśvā -mitra. Rāma was first unwilling to bend his bow, against a woman, but the sage overcame his scruples. See [[R. 11. 20]]]. 
__2 The large dark-green pumpkin.
[ताडकाया अपत्यं ढक्] An epithet of the demon Mārīcha, son of Tāḍakā.

ताडङ्कः,
ताडपत्रम् See ताटङ्कम्; विश्वासाय स्वताडङ्कपाणिं कृत्वा प्रयागकम् [[Rāj. T. 7. 749.]]

a. 
(-गी f.) Being in or coming from tanks.

ताडिः,
 
-डी f. 
__1 A kind of palm. 
__2 A kind of ornament (also ताडि (डी) दल); ताडीदलेन श्रवणान्निपत्य [[Vikr. 12. 12.]]
